references.text: The Lord drives out nations greater and more powerful than Israel before them
Israel shall cross the Jordan to drive out nations greater and more powerful than themselves
The Lord drives out the nations before Israel and gives them the land as an inheritance
The Lord will drive out all these nations before Israel, and they shall take possession of nations greater and more powerful
Israel shall take possession of the land and settle there, for the Lord has given them the land as a possession
The living God will drive out the Canaanites and other nations before Israel
The Lord drove out great and mighty nations before Israel
God drove out the nations with His hand and planted the fathers in the land
God drove out pagan peoples before Israel and let them dwell in their tents as an inheritance
God drove out pagan peoples before the fathers, all the way to the days of David
God wiped out seven peoples in the land of Canaan and gave Israel their land as an inheritance
